docs.title: Daniel Chu: A Real Person
docs.text: This is my personal website in which I try to prove that I am a real person with real skills and abilities.

docs.title: Experience Daniel
docs.text:
• The CV page contains some information on my education and experience. Please contact me directly to receive the latest version.
  • Alternatively, my Google Scholar profile can attest that I am a real person with real publications.
  • All of the software I have produced or manage can be found at my Github profile.
  • I also have a LinkedIn profile. This profile also professes that I am a real person.

docs.title: Communicate with Daniel
docs.text:
Email: danielchu@danielchu.horse

I try to respond to all emails that fall under one or more of the following categories:

  • Job opportunities.
  • Academic collaborations. I also occasionally do academic consulting work for research design and data [management, engineering, science] in health behavior.
  • PDF fulltext requests for any of the published articles listed in my CV.
  • Questions regarding the theoretical underpinnings of any of the software I have written. Please use Github for any technical questions or comments. Also, the very rare update request in case if someone accidentally uses anything I've created.

Emails that include any of the following attributes listed below may elicit a response from me but the probability is low.

  • Requests to submit manuscripts to shady journals with very long names.
  • Anything from Anthony Lloyd Weber, composer of the musical Cats.
